job.jobDescription:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking talented Software Engineers to build next-generation cloud infrastructure. Work on systems that are used by millions of customers globally.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and maintain AWS cloud services
  • Solve complex technical challenges at scale
  • Own features from design through deployment
  • Collaborate with teams across Amazon
  • Drive operational excellence

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of software development experience
  • Experience with object-oriented programming
  • Strong CS fundamentals
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AWS services
  • Distributed systems experience
  • Master's degree in Computer Science
